meta.name: pr-to-video
meta.description: Turn a GitHub pull request (a PR URL, owner/repo#N, or 'this PR' in a checked-out repo) into a code-change explainer video — changelog, feature reveal, fix, or refactor walkthrough built from the diff, commits, and files: the input is a code change, not a website. Not a product promo (/product-launch-video) or a no-PR topic explainer (/faceless-explainer). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把 GitHub 拉取请求的代码改动变成一段讲解视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果团队要把每次代码改动讲给不懂代码的人听
copy.tagline_en: Turn a GitHub pull request into a narrated code-change explainer video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you must explain code changes to non-technical teammates.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会读取你给的 GitHub PR（diff、提交、文件），规划分镜并逐帧搭建一支代码改动讲解视频，最后渲染出 renders/video.mp4。
howto.when: 当你提供 GitHub PR——PR 链接、owner/repo#N，或检出仓库里的「this PR」时接管。产品宣传片和无 PR 的话题讲解不走这里，意图不明则先走 /hyperframes。

say.text: 把这个 PR 做成改动讲解视频：acme/sdk#1842
say.note: 会抓取 diff 和提交，再规划分镜

say.text: 给当前检出仓库的这个 PR 做一支修复讲解视频
say.note: 按仓库里的 PR 走，不用再报编号

say.text: 用男声旁白做这个 PR 的改动讲解视频
say.note: 旁白会按你指定的声音生成

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude reads the GitHub PR you give it (diff, commits, files), plans a storyboard, and builds a code-change explainer frame by frame, ending in renders/video.mp4.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you provide a GitHub pull request — a PR URL, owner/repo#N, or "this PR" in a checked-out repo. Product promos and no-PR topic explainers don't route here; unclear intent goes to /hyperframes first.

say_en.text: Turn this PR into a code-change explainer: acme/sdk#1842
say_en.note: Fetches the diff and commits, then plans the storyboard

say_en.text: Make a fix explainer video for this PR in the current repo
say_en.note: Uses the PR checked out here, no number needed

say_en.text: Do this PR explainer with a male narration voice
say_en.note: Narration is generated with the chosen voice
